answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 245 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the velvet. The prism index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the lotus queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. A 300 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
